design_philosophy: Traditional Sanskrit-inspired ornate design fused with modern premium dark mode. Combines deep cosmic backgrounds with glowing saffron and gold accents to evoke ancient astrological wisdom and luxury.

hero.layout: Centered content over dark cosmic background image with heavy black gradient overlay.
hero.elements: H1 Title (Cormorant), Overline, Primary CTA, subtle floating gold mandala SVG behind text.

tiers.free: Glass card, basic features listed, secondary button.
tiers.basic: Surface card, saffron subtle glow border, primary button.
tiers.premium: Premium card with double inner borders, glowing gold button, 'Most Popular' sash in deep red.

free_tier.layout: Split section: Grahas (9 planets) and Nakshatras (27 constellations).
free_tier.grahas: Grid of 9 circular ornate avatars (grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-9), hover lift effect.
free_tier.nakshatras: Masonry or dense grid with traditional sanskrit names and minimal descriptions.

basic_tier.layout: Centered form (max-w-xl) inside a glass card.
basic_tier.form_fields: Date of Birth (DatePicker), Time of Birth (Time/Select), Place of Birth (Input).
basic_tier.result: AI-generated text response styled as an ancient scroll or clean typography block with serif fonts.

premium_tier.layout: Two-column dashboard layout after form submission.
premium_tier.left_col: North Indian Kundali Chart (SVG) rendered prominently.
premium_tier.right_col: Shadcn Table for Planetary Positions + AI detailed interpretation in a scrollable glass container.

auth.layout: Split screen: Left side cosmic image, Right side minimalist login/register form.

hero_background.description: Deep purple and blue cosmic galaxy with stars. MUST be overlaid with bg-black/70 to ensure text readability.

premium_texture.description: Vintage parchment texture. Use as a subtle multiply/overlay blend mode inside premium cards or AI advice output with low opacity (10-15%).

ornate_abstract.description: Abstract golden organic sculpture. Use as a side image for Auth page or as a floating decorative element in the Premium Tier page.

animations.hover: All interactive elements must have a transition-all duration-300. Cards should translate-y-[-4px] and increase shadow.
animations.entrance: Staggered fade-up (framer-motion) for the pricing tiers and Grahas grid.
animations.kundali: When rendering the Kundali SVG, path elements should draw in (stroke-dasharray animation) over 1.5 seconds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds has at least 4.5:1 contrast. Saffron text on dark navy is acceptable for large text.
accessibility.focus: All forms must have clear focus rings (ring-1 ring-brand-primary).
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid to all forms, submit buttons, tier selection buttons, and auth inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and tables. Ensure they are customized to match the dark theme and saffron accents.
For the Kundali Chart, DO NOT use an external image. Build a React component that returns an inline SVG rendering a North Indian style diamond chart.
The hero section MUST use the hero_background image with a heavy black overlay (e.g., bg-black/70) so the Cormorant Garamond headings are perfectly legible.
For 'Sanskrit-inspired' feel, rely heavily on the 'Cormorant Garamond' font for headings and uppercase 'Cinzel' for small overlines. Do not use cliché handwritten fonts.
The AI advice response should be rendered beautifully, not just as plain text. Consider wrapping it in a container that uses the parchment texture faintly.
Mock the subscription flow by setting a user state or JWT claim; no actual Stripe integration needed.
Use lucide-react for standard icons, but consider generating basic SVGs for the 9 Grahas if specific iconography is needed, or just use elegant typography for their names.
